시편-5-1.title: 시편 5장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-1.exegesis: 8. both lay me down, &c.-- or, will lie down at once, and sleep in sure confidence and quiet repose ( Psa 3:5 ).
시편-5-1.theologicalNote: 8. both lay me down, &c.-- or, will lie down at once, and sleep in sure confidence and quiet repose ( Psa 3:5 ).

시편-5-2.title: 시편 5장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-2.exegesis: PSALM 5 Psa 5:1-12 . Upon Nehiloth--flutes or wind instruments. The writer begs to be heard, on the ground of God's regard for His covenant-people and true worshippers as contrasted with His holy hatred to the wicked. He prays for divine guidance, on account of his watchful, malignant, and deceitful enemies; and for their destruction as being also God's enemies. At the same time he expresses his confidence that God will extend aid to His people. 1. meditation-- moanings of that half-uttered form to which deep feeling gives rise--groanings, as in Ro 8:26 , 27 .

시편-5-3.title: 시편 5장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-3.exegesis: 2. Hearken-- incline the ear ( Psa 10:17 ; compare Psa 61:2 )--give close attention. my cry-- that is, for help ( Psa 61:2 ; Jr 8:19 ). my King-- thus by covenant relation interested in my cause.
시편-5-3.theologicalNote: 2. Hearken-- incline the ear ( Psa 10:17 ; compare Psa 61:2 )--give close attention. my cry-- that is, for help ( Psa 61:2 ; Jr 8:19 ). my King-- thus by covenant relation interested in my cause.

시편-5-4.title: 시편 5장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-4.exegesis: 3. direct-- literally, "set in order," as the showbread was placed or set in order ( Ex 40:23 ).
시편-5-4.theologicalNote: 3. direct-- literally, "set in order," as the showbread was placed or set in order ( Ex 40:23 ).

시편-5-5.title: 시편 5장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-5.exegesis: 4. For, &c.-- God only regards sincere worshippers. evil-- or, "the evil man." dwell-- lodge, remain under protection.
시편-5-5.theologicalNote: 4. For, &c.-- God only regards sincere worshippers. evil-- or, "the evil man." dwell-- lodge, remain under protection.

시편-5-6.title: 시편 5장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-6.exegesis: 5. foolish-- vainglorious and insolent. iniquity-- especially such as denotes a negation, or defect, that is, of moral principle.
시편-5-6.theologicalNote: 5. foolish-- vainglorious and insolent. iniquity-- especially such as denotes a negation, or defect, that is, of moral principle.

시편-5-7.title: 시편 5장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-7.exegesis: 6. leasing-- a lie. the bloody ... man-- literally, "man of blood"--murderer.
시편-5-7.theologicalNote: 6. leasing-- a lie. the bloody ... man-- literally, "man of blood"--murderer.

시편-5-8.title: 시편 5장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-8.exegesis: 7. But-- as in Psa 2:6 , literally, "and." house-- ( 1Ch 9:23 ), the tabernacle. temple-- literally, "palace," applied to God's residence, the Holy of Holies ( 1Sa 3:3 ; 2Sa 22:7 ); the inner part of the tabernacle. toward-- not in; the high priest alone was allowed to enter.
시편-5-8.theologicalNote: 7. 시편-5-9.title: 시편 5장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-9.exegesis: 8. enemies-- literally, "watchers" ( Psa 27:11 ), hence special need of guidance. in thy righteousness-- an attribute implying faithfulness in promises as well as threatenings. make thy way straight-- that is, make the way of providence plain.
시편-5-9.theologicalNote: 8. enemies-- literally, "watchers" ( Psa 27:11 ), hence special need of guidance. in thy righteousness-- an attribute implying faithfulness in promises as well as threatenings. make thy way straight-- that is, make the way of providence plain.

시편-5-10.title: 시편 5장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-10.exegesis: 9. The wicked are not reliable because by nature they are full of wickedness, or literally, "wickednesses," of every kind ( Ro 8:7 ). sepulchre-- a dwelling-place of corruption, emitting moral putridness. flatter-- or, "make smooth." their tongue-- speaks deceitfully.
시편-5-10.theologicalNote: 9. The wicked are not reliable because by nature they are full of wickedness, or literally, "wickednesses," of every kind ( Ro 8:7 ). sepulchre-- a dwelling-place of corruption, emitting moral putridness. flatter-- or, "make smooth." their tongue-- speaks deceitfully.

시편-5-11.title: 시편 5장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-11.exegesis: 10. Destroy-- or, "condemn" them to destruction as guilty.
시편-5-11.theologicalNote: 10. Destroy-- or, "condemn" them to destruction as guilty.

시편-5-12.title: 시편 5장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-5-12.exegesis: 11. defendest-- (compare Margin). love thy name-- Thy manifested perfections ( Psa 9:10 ).
시편-5-12.theologicalNote: 11. defendest-- (compare Margin). love thy name-- Thy manifested perfections ( Psa 9:10 ).
